Governance of the ADHD quality improvement initiatives is overseen by the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (steering committee), which evaluates and adjusts clinical indicators based on systemic capacities and legislative shifts. In the upcoming year, the committee's primary governance focus is directed toward [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] [^src1]. This prioritization is driven by a combination of rising patient volumes, a critical shortage of [[speciallaeger|speciallæger]] (specialist doctors), and recent legislative changes that now permit [[specialpsykolog|specialpsykologer]] (specialist psychologists) to independently issue diagnoses [^src1].

In addition to these operational adjustments, the steering committee is actively reviewing the structural inclusion of other metrics. Specifically, a final decision is pending regarding [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]; the committee will determine at their next meeting whether this metric should be reclassified to serve merely as supplementary material rather than a primary indicator [^src2].
